We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Internal Auditor
Job Location: Gwarimpa, Abuja
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role


	We are seeking a diligent Internal Auditor to join our real estate firm.
	The successful candidate will evaluate and enhance the effectiveness of internal controls, risk management, and governance processes across the company.
	This role ensures compliance with company policies, financial regulations, and operational standards within the real estate sector.


Key Responsibilities


	Conduct periodic internal audits of financial, operational, and administrative processes within the real estate business.
	Review financial records, transactions, and reports for accuracy and compliance.
	Assess internal control systems and identify areas of risk or weakness.
	Ensure adherence to company policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
	Prepare audit reports detailing findings, risks, and actionable recommendations.
	Follow up on audit findings to confirm corrective actions are implemented.
	Support management in fraud prevention and detection initiatives.
	Collaborate with departments to enhance processes and operational efficiency.
	Maintain comprehensive documentation of audit activities and evidence.
	Assist during external audits as required.


Requirements &amp; Qualifications


	Bachelor&rsquo;s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related field.
	Minimum of 5 years of experience in internal audit or a related role.
	Professional certification (ICAN, ACCA, CIA) is an advantage.
	Strong understanding of internal controls, auditing standards, and risk management.
	High level of integrity, confidentiality, and attention to detail.
	Excellent analytical and report-writing skills.
	Proficient in Microsoft Excel and accounting/audit software.


Key Competencies:


	Analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
	Strong attention to detail
	Ethical judgment and integrity
	Effective communication and interpersonal skills


Method of Application&nbsp;

	We are seeking a creative, results-driven, and experienced Digital Marketer to join our marketing team.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and executing digital marketing strategies that increase brand visibility, generate qualified leads, promote our real estate properties and services, and contribute directly to customer acquisition and revenue growth.
	The ideal candidate should have strong experience in digital marketing, particularly in lead generation, social media marketing, paid advertising, content marketing, and campaign optimization, with an understanding of the real estate industry being an added advantage.

	Develop and execute digital marketing strategies aligned with the Company&#39;s real estate marketing and revenue objectives.
	Plan, launch, manage, and optimize digital advertising campaigns across platforms such as Meta (Facebook and Instagram), Google Ads, TikTok, and other relevant platforms.
	Generate qualified leads for properties, land, houses, and other Company offerings through digital marketing campaigns.
	Develop and implement strategies to improve lead quality, conversion, and customer acquisition.
	Manage and grow the Company&#39;s social media presence across relevant platforms.
	Create and coordinate engaging content for social media, websites, blogs, email campaigns, and other digital platforms.
	Work closely with the Creative, Customer Relations, and Sales Teams to ensure that digital leads are properly captured, followed up, and converted.

	Conduct market and competitor research to identify emerging trends, customer preferences, and new digital marketing opportunities.
	Manage the Company&#39;s digital marketing budget effectively and ensure optimal return on advertising spend.
	Monitor website performance, traffic, SEO rankings, and other relevant digital marketing metrics.
	Develop and implement SEO strategies to improve the Company&#39;s online visibility and organic traffic.
	Manage email and other digital communication campaigns where applicable.
	Track and report on the performance of all digital marketing activities on a weekly and monthly basis.
	Stay updated on emerging digital marketing trends, platforms, tools, and best practices.
	Collaborate with other departments to ensure consistency in brand messaging and alignment with overall business objectives.
	Continuously test new marketing approaches, creatives, audiences, and channels to improve lead generation and revenue.

	Strong experience managing Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, and other paid advertising platforms.
	Strong understanding of SEO, SEM, PPC, social media marketing, email marketing, content marketing, and lead generation.
	Proven experience generating and managing leads through digital marketing campaigns.
	Proficiency in Google Analytics/GA4, Google Search Console, Meta Business Suite/Ads Manager, and other relevant marketing tools.
	Strong analytical and data interpretation skills.
	Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
	Strong understanding of social media trends and digital consumer behaviour.
	Ability to develop compelling marketing campaigns and content strategies.
	Strong organizational, problem-solving, and project management skills.
	Ability to work collaboratively with Creative, CRM, Sales, and other teams.
	Ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
